name: AI Usage
author: Cees Kettenis
description: Cached OpenAI and Claude usage across multiple local profiles.

barWidget.description: Show cached OpenAI and Claude limits for every configured profile.

schema.label: OpenAI profiles folder
schema.description: A Codex home or a folder whose immediate subfolders contain Codex auth.json files.

schema.label: Claude account setup
schema.description: Use ~/.claude directly or scan a parent folder containing separate Claude config homes.

schema.label: Claude single-account location
schema.description: The CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR home for one Claude account.

schema.label: Claude multiple-account location
schema.description: A parent folder whose immediate subfolders are separate CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR homes.

schema.label: OpenAI refresh mode
schema.description: Fetch OpenAI API usage on interaction, on the configured schedule, or both. Claude usage arrives through Claude Code's status line.

schema.label: OpenAI hover cooldown (seconds)
schema.description: Minimum time between hover-triggered OpenAI API refreshes.

schema.label: Privacy mode
schema.description: Hide account email and subscription details in the popup.

schema.label: OpenAI refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: Interval between scheduled OpenAI API refreshes.

schema.label: Sleep mode
schema.description: Pause scheduled OpenAI usage checks during the configured sleep window.
